description: This file defines interfaces, utility functions, and the TensorExprKernel class for tensor expression compilation and execution within the Torch JIT framework, specifically related to tensor shape handling, broadcasting, kernel code generation, and support checks for operations like conv2d and matmul.

classes.name: TensorExprKernel
classes.description: A class responsible for compiling, managing, and executing tensor expression kernels within the Torch JIT framework, supporting code generation, shape handling, and fallback mechanisms.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the kernel with the provided stack of inputs and outputs.

methods.name: runFast
methods.description: Executes the kernel with raw input and output pointers for performance.

methods.name: runWithAllocatedOutputs
methods.description: Runs the kernel with pre-allocated output tensors.

methods.name: recompile
methods.description: Recompiles the kernel code, possibly after graph modifications.

methods.name: getCodeGenStmt
methods.description: Returns the code generation statement for the kernel.

methods.name: getCodeText
methods.description: Returns the generated kernel code as text.

methods.name: getConstantDescriptors
methods.description: Returns descriptors for constant tensors used in the kernel.

methods.name: getBufferArgs
methods.description: Returns buffer arguments for code generation.
